Final epic-level completion-verifier verdict (2026-05-12 post-fix):
- SC1, SC2, SC3, SC4 (mode/branch/trailer/leakage): PASS (story-level trust)
- SC4_epic (region-split overlapping-region MAX-severity/dual-rationale dedup test): PASS (commit 965d59bb; tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_split.py 7/7)
- SC5_epic (DefenseStore SHA-range merge-survival + foreign-SHA exclusion): PASS (commit 965d59bb; test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh 2/2, test-defense-store-sha-range.sh 9/9)
- SC6 (4724-41a7 worktree base SHA): PASS (story 49c1-3272 closed; regression tests in place)
- SC7 (consumer impact + S6/S6_5 stories): PASS (3d09-1ba7 + 6068-069d closed)
- SC8 (validation acceptance with real end-to-end sprint): **FACTUALLY FAIL** — see DD1_OVERRIDE on ea41-a8d8. User override applied; gap remains traceable via:
  - Bug ada8-4478 (P2, OPEN) — litellm missing in CI runner; blocks real per-story CI llm-review.
  - Bug 67a5-5da5 (P3, OPEN) — workflow upload step omits reviewer-findings.json path.
  - Both linked as f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d dependencies.
- SC9 (coverage gate, preventions_count >= 100): PASS (100/100)
- SC13 (restart-rate analysis informational): informational FAIL — new bug filed (P4) for sample_size=0 ZeroDivisionError; does not affect overall_verdict.
- SC14 (FP rate): PASS

Closing epic under explicit user override on SC8 only. Real validation sprint must follow resolution of ada8-4478 and 67a5-5da5.
